messages:
ana (eng-releases): deploy-bot alerted on post-deploy synth failure for /chat-sim canary 316
deploy-bot: Canary 316: synth-check failed (5/20 tests). primary error: embed-lookup schema mismatch -> 5xx. logs: https://logs.redwood/canary/316
mike (oncall): noticed p95 spike and several 504s from inference-proxy at ~15:03 UTC. failing samples look like long bracketed prompts (weird tokenization)
elin (sre): confirmed proxy 504s and backend p95 climb on the canary hosts. no OOMs, CPU fine.
carla (eng): suggestion: pin route to previous model-variant so we stop exposing traffic while triaging. prefer pin > full rollback during window
mike (oncall): +1 to pin, will this cause cache cold starts and worse tails?
elin (sre): some tail from warmup but acceptable compared to ongoing 504s. recommend pin now, replay the failing synth subset
carla (eng): starting targeted replay of failing payloads. repro curl below:
```
curl -X POST https://staging-api.internal/v1/simulate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"route":"/chat-sim","prompt":"[LONG USER PROMPT WITH MULTIPLE [[BRACKETS]] AND EMOJI 🤖]"}'
```
deploy-bot: Applying rollout hold and pinning route. action: hold applied by @mike; chat-sim pinned -> model:v2026-03-20-stable; announcements posted to #eng-releases and #eng-oncall
ana (typo): ignore previous accidental message
carla (eng): replay logs point to tokenizer split differences between v2026-03-20 and v2026-03-22-build. subword splits differ -> embed lookup path getting unexpected token ids
elin (sre): if tokenizer config drift is root cause, hotpatching tokenizer config is lower risk than full model rollback. ops can do a config hotpatch within the window?
ops-bot: Hotpatch request queued: job=job-8842, action=tokenizer-config-revert, ETA ~40m. Notifying ops oncall.
mike (oncall): OK to proceed with hotpatch. keep hold until synth subset passes. I'll update release notes: "canary 316: hold - pinned chat-sim to v2026-03-20-stable while triaging synth failures (tokenizer mismatch)"
carla (eng): plan: 1) apply hotpatch 2) run failing subset 3) if pass -> full synthetic run, lift hold and continue canary 4) if fail -> rollback model and open postmortem
elin (sre): will monitor p95, 5xx, and tokenization diffs. tagging alerts for immediate pager if errors spike
mike (oncall): thanks all. I'll also tag the PR with the hold reason and link logs. :thumbsup:
